title: Design excellence
description: A site or interface that looks made for this brand and works for everyone. Scores taste, craft and verified behavior, not effects.

criteria.title: Could only be this brand
criteria.ask: Swap the logo for another company's: does the page still work as theirs? Count the deliberate, non-default decisions (type, color, layout, motion, copy) and tie each to the brief.
criteria.evidence: At least three non-default decisions with the brief sentence that justifies each, and a clean `helen design check` report.

criteria.title: Clear hierarchy
criteria.ask: At each viewport, where does the eye land first, second, third? Is that the order the page needs?
criteria.evidence: Screenshots at 375, 768 and 1440 px with the reading order marked.

criteria.title: Typography with intent
criteria.ask: Are the families chosen for this brand rather than defaulted? Is there a scale, a readable measure (45-75 characters) and sound line height?
criteria.evidence: Families, scale steps, measure and line-height values read from the computed styles.

criteria.title: Restrained, accessible color
criteria.ask: Few colors with clear roles? Do all text and interactive pairs meet WCAG AA contrast?
criteria.evidence: Contrast ratios for every text/background and control pair.

criteria.title: Layout rhythm
criteria.ask: Is spacing drawn from one scale and is alignment consistent, or is each section a one-off?
criteria.evidence: The spacing scale and a check that sections follow it.

criteria.title: Truly responsive
criteria.ask: Does it work at 375, 768 and 1440 px: no horizontal scroll, touch targets of 44 px or more, nothing clipped?
criteria.evidence: Real browser screenshots or measurements at the three widths.

criteria.title: No invented content
criteria.ask: Is every testimonial, metric, logo and claim real or clearly marked as a placeholder? Is there any lorem ipsum?
criteria.evidence: A list of every claim and its source, or the placeholder marker.

criteria.title: Accessible
criteria.ask: Keyboard order, visible focus, semantic landmarks, labels, alt text, reduced-motion respected?
criteria.evidence: Keyboard walkthrough notes and an automated audit result.

criteria.title: Motion with a purpose
criteria.ask: Does each animation explain or guide something, and does `prefers-reduced-motion` switch it off?
criteria.evidence: Each animation with its purpose, and the reduced-motion behavior.

criteria.title: Fast enough
criteria.ask: Are images sized and in modern formats, fonts loaded sensibly, layout shift avoided?
criteria.evidence: Measured LCP and CLS, or the build output sizes.

criteria.title: Every state designed
criteria.ask: Hover, focus, active, disabled, empty, loading, error and 404: designed or default?
